item.title: LETTER: More enforcement needed on foreign-flagged boats
item.description: The demand for Alaska’s wilderness is increasing, but foreign-flagged boats and un-permitted pirate operators are pushing out local companies. Recently, the Coast Guard stopped a foreign-built charter vessel that was running illegally, competing with local Alaskan companies. The charter was terminated, and the vessel was escorted back to Sitka. This is a good first step, but there are still many more illegally running vessels that are damaging legal U.S. businesses.

item.title: LETTER: Time to take a stand on needless gun deaths
item.description: With September being Suicide Prevention Awareness Month, and Juneau the capital city of this magnificent, resplendent, peaceful tranquility we call home — Alaska — our Juneau Empire needs to humbly herald to our brothers and sisters, as well as our LGBTQ cis communities, and most acutely to our legislators as we implore their rule-making efforts, to ensure that a life, even if momentarily clouded and prone to impulsive depression, is not immediately resolved with an improperly secured firearm.
